title: Superparticular
summary: SUPERPARTIC'ULAR, adjective [super and particular.] Noting a ratio when the excess of the greater term is a unit; as the ratio of 1 to 2, or of 3 to 4.

inlines.v: SUPERPARTIC'ULAR, adjective [super and particular.] Noting a ratio when the excess of the greater term is a unit; as the ratio of 1 to 2, or of 3 to 4.
